issues.title: Broken External References
issues.why: The DDL for App and AppLink relies on Profile, GitProfile, and Repo tables, but their schemas are not provided in this context, only referenced via external paths.
issues.fix: Inline the minimal DDL for Profile, GitProfile, and Repo tables in the 'Convention recap' or a 'Prerequisites' section.

issues.title: Conflicting DDL Dialects
issues.why: The spec provides SQLite DDL (PascalCase, INTEGER types) in the main section but then provides PostgreSQL DDL (snake_case, UUIDs) in the Phase 53 section without stating which is the primary target.
issues.fix: Explicitly designate one DDL block as the 'Primary Implementation Target' and the other as 'Reference/Secondary'.

issues.title: Unresolved CHECK Constraint Logic
issues.why: The AppLink CHECK constraint uses subqueries (SELECT AppLinkTypeId FROM AppLinkType...). SQLite does not allow subqueries inside CHECK constraints.
issues.fix: Replace subqueries in CHECK constraints with hardcoded ID constants or use a Trigger/Application logic to enforce the XOR invariant.
